title: Actor
description: One actor's config file, .troupe/actors/<name>.yaml. The file's name is the actor's name. Its character, when it has one, is the whole of .troupe/actors/<name>.md. troupe writes this file from the theatre's config events, and every field is set with troupe config set.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Where this file's schema is, relative to the file, so editors can check it. troupe writes it.

runner.title: Runner
runner.description: The runner that runs this actor, by name.

options.title: Runner options
options.description: The runner's own options, passed to it unchanged. Absent means {}. An extension point: the runner's published options schema fills it, and without one only {} validates.

expect.title: Effect check
expect.description: Files, relative to the theatre's root, that a run must create or change: each must exist after the run, and differ from before it, and each must match a write or move pattern in effects. A file named twice is checked once. An empty list means no file has to change; the run's changes are still audited against its effects. It has to be written.

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: What this actor's runs may change: write, delete and move, each a list of patterns relative to the theatre's root. Absent declares nothing, so the actor is read-only. Every path in expect must match a write or move pattern. After each run, troupe audits every change in the workspace against it. Not enforcement: only a stage that enforces effects contains a run.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Where a run works. worktree, the default when absent: the run's own git worktree at HEAD, under .troupe/local/worktrees/, whose changes reach the theatre only through troupe accept. theatre: the theatre itself, so what the run writes lands among your files at once.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: The runtime this actor's runs talk to, by name: one of troupe's built-in runtimes or one in config. Only for a runner that takes a runtime; required by one that needs it.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model this actor's runs use, overriding its runtime's. The person's TROUPE_RUNTIME_<NAME>_MODEL overrides both. Only with a runtime.

runnerOptions.title: The runner's options
runnerOptions.description: The default for the runnerOptions extension point: no options.
